description: Add/drop, enrollment status, grades, transcripts, attendance records in the SIS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Enrollment status drives Title IV eligibility and disbursement; start dates run every 6 weeks; SIS vendor RPO 1 h (P09)
manual_workaround: Printed class rosters; paper add/drop log keyed in after restore

description: Online IT courses, assignments, exams, and academic activity records in the LMS
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 300 online students cannot attend; academic activity records support attendance and aid decisions; exam windows
manual_workaround: Extend deadlines; email course materials; faculty record activity manually

business_process: Title IV aid processing and disbursement
description: ISIR import through SAIG, verification, packaging, origination, disbursement records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 80% of revenue depends on Title IV; disbursement weeks follow each start date; late packaging delays credit balance refunds (see BP-04)
manual_workaround: Process from SAIG downloads on the 2 workstations; manual award log; delay non-urgent packaging
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-01; SYS-06; SYS-08 integration server
dependent_third_parties: FAMS vendor; financial aid servicer; Department of Education

business_process: Student accounts and credit balance refunds
description: Tuition charges, aid posting, refund calculation and bank payment file
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Title IV credit balances must be paid no later than 14 days after they occur (34 CFR 668.164(h)(2)); students rely on refunds for living costs
manual_workaround: Calculate urgent refunds from FAMS award letters and pay by check

description: Classroom and lab instruction for healthcare and IT programs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Lab hours are required for program completion and clinical placement; sessions can be rescheduled within the term
manual_workaround: Paper attendance; reschedule labs; use healthcare skills labs without PCs

description: Inquiries, applications, interviews, enrollment agreements in the CRM
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Next start date cohort; lost leads go to competitors
manual_workaround: Phone and paper applications; spreadsheet lead log

description: Email, chat, and campus emergency notifications
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency and weather notices must reach students and staff quickly
manual_workaround: Text message alert service (separate vendor); phone tree
dependent_third_parties: Productivity SaaS vendor; alert service vendor

business_process: Student success advising and early alert
description: Advisor outreach, early-alert risk scores, intervention records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advising can pause a week; at-risk students still reachable through faculty
dependent_systems: SYS-01 analytics module; SYS-08 reporting database

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding and terminations

manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll through the payroll provider

description: Department of Education and accreditor reports, compliance audit support
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reporting deadlines are weeks away at any given time
